$comment: Values the shared CI checks in .agents/_shared/scripts need for this repo (agent-skills README, Shared CI checks). Run from ci.yml.

functionsLoadedMemory._budgetMib: RSS after gc() of the esbuild bundle on the CI runner, +10 MiB so a growth like Órdago's 17 MiB pubsub import fails. The CI runner read 164.1 MiB on 2026-11-27 (a workstation reads ~176, so a local run may fail where CI passes); most functions here run at the 256 MiB default. Raise it only in a PR that says what the extra megabytes buy.
